name: Eleni Papadopoulos
bio:
Eleni's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during her university years, where she studied mechanical engineering. A chance encounter with a local racing team ignited a passion that led her to abandon her initial career aspirations and dedicate herself to the world of competitive racing. Over the past two decades, Eleni has honed her skills as a strategist, working with various teams across different racing series. Her ability to analyze complex data sets and identify crucial strategic advantages has earned her a reputation as a highly sought-after talent. 

Eleni's approach to strategy is rooted in a deep understanding of both the technical aspects of the car and the dynamic nature of race conditions. She excels at anticipating the moves of competitors and adapting her team's strategy accordingly. Known for her calm demeanor under pressure, Eleni is able to make critical decisions in the heat of the moment, ensuring that her team remains competitive even in the most challenging circumstances. Her holistic perspective, combined with an innovative mindset, makes her a valuable asset to Team Penske.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back into a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Eleni has a warm smile and a focused gaze, with a practical but elegant style.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook filled with race data and personal notes.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on having a cup of strong Greek coffee before every race.
